segments.text:
V. 27.
Eſpouſed—It was cuſtomary among the Jews, for Perſons that married, to contract before Witneſſes ſome time before. And as Chriſt was to be be b••• of a pure Virgin, ſo the Wiſdom of GOD ordered it to be of one eſpouſed, that to prevent Reproach He might have a reputed Father, according to the Fleſh.
